shared_elements: horizontal registers separated by plain dividing bands
low-relief carving on a wall surface
repeated motifs in a row along a band
rosette-like/floral elements (a small rosette frieze appears in B's dividing band)
justification: Both surfaces are wall reliefs organised into stacked horizontal registers divided by plain bands with repeated motifs marching along each band, and B's narrow dividing frieze of small rosettes echoes A's row of multi-petalled rosettes. But the depicted content is otherwise wholly different: A shows only vegetal ornament (rosettes, palmette-and-lotus scroll, an arcade of scale/net-filled forms) with no living figures, while B shows processions of standing human figures in profile with staffs, horses and chariots.
